<!-- English or French, both are fine. Anglais ou français, les deux conviennent. -->

## What would you like to do? / Que voulez-vous pouvoir faire ?

<!-- Describe the need first (what you are trying to do), then your idea. -->

## What do you do today instead? / Que faites-vous aujourd'hui à la place ?

<!-- A workaround, another tool, or nothing. -->

## Where would it apply? / Où cela s'appliquerait-il ?

- [ ] Keys (LCD buttons)
- [ ] Screen
- [ ] Dials
- [ ] Galleon Bosun (settings app)
- [ ] Gaming mode / widgets
- [ ] Packaging or installation
- [ ] Documentation or website
- [ ] Other:

## Platform / Plateforme

- [ ] Linux
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Both

## Hardware or protocol involved / Matériel ou protocole concerné

<!-- If the idea needs something the module is not known to do, say so.
     GalleonCore does not invent protocol bytes: such a change needs a cited
     source or a real capture (sanitized, no serial number or keystrokes). -->
